name: Managing Digital Transformation
description: If digital is the new normal, what is in store for companies that were established long before this digital revolution? Is it game over for them? Is it all about the Amazons, Googles, and Facebooks now? This course tries to explore these and related other questions. Using examples of firms that were entrenched in erstwhile economic and institutional logics, but were successfully able to transform and adapt to the digital age, this course will delineate nuggets of wisdom for managers and CXOs to manage the digital transformation of their – often behemoth, hard to maneuver – organizations. The course will look at different aspects that make digital transformation successful. We will explore how the success of digital transformations often depends on the digital strategies chosen for change, technological leadership, adoption of appropriate tech-based business models, and understanding of the most cutting-edge technologies like augmented/virtual reality, internet of things, artificial intelligence and blockchain. The pedagogy would be inclined towards encouraging collective peer learning in class. Case analysis will be used to understand successful real-world digital transformation of organizations. Discussions will be based on recent events and current business debates/discussions. In-class exercises will be utilized to encourage the participants to think and come up with innovative solutions to make sense of an increasingly digital environment. Guest speakers will also be invited to give the participants the option to learn from real-life experiences. The course will include project work to enable participants to apply their learning to real life problems.
